The text you type is sent to Google\'s search service (Android) to find the place. Your location is never sent. Without search, the map and favourites work offline.
No favourites. Choose a destination, then add it.
Location not found. Turn on location and try again.
You seem to have arrived. Confirm with your PIN.
Alert my contacts if my phone goes silent
During the trip, the server receives your position every 2 min. With no news for 10 min, up to 3 contacts who accepted get an SMS with your last position. Everything is erased when the trip ends.
To let the server alert your contacts if your phone goes silent, verify your number (Settings, My number).
Server monitoring on. Contacts alerted if the phone goes silent: %1$d
No contact has accepted your invitation yet: server monitoring is not active.
Server monitoring unavailable (%1$s). The trip continues on the phone.
No points are kept: only the latest positions stay in memory, erased on arrival.
Listening: only your secret phrase is looked for
AI listening paused: another app is using the microphone
Listening off. It starts with protection, if a secret phrase is saved.
Everything happens on the phone. No sound is recorded or sent: only an encrypted fingerprint of your phrase is kept.
Choose a short, unusual phrase (2 to 4 words), in your language. Said during protection, it sends a silent alert to your contacts, with nothing on screen.
The fingerprint will be erased. Listening will look for nothing until you save a new one.
Nothing heard. Speak closer to the phone and try again.
Phrase too short: choose one of 2 to 4 words.
Phrase too long: 4 seconds at most.
Too quiet: speak a little louder.
The 3 repetitions are not alike enough. Say the same phrase, the same way.
Phrase recognised. Nothing was sent: this was a test.
Not recognised. Try again, or record the phrase again somewhere quiet.

During an alert (level 2 or SOS), the microphone records. It may capture other people\'s voices. The recording stays encrypted on your phone; its value in court is not guaranteed. You can turn it off in \"Evidence\".
Vault locked. Enter your PIN to see the recordings.
Level 2 or SOS only. Encrypted on the phone, erased according to your chosen duration.
Tampering detected: the recording was changed or damaged.
For a complaint: keep the recording longer (90 days at most).
The encryption key is destroyed, then the file is erased. This cannot be undone.
Cannot read: the recording is damaged.
Code to give separately (out loud or by SMS), never with the file:
The file is encrypted: without this code, nobody can open it. It will not be shown again.
Recordings prove they were not changed (fingerprint chain), but their value in court depends on the country and the judge.

resources.string: AI listening paused: low battery or phone too hot. SOS still works.
Could not delete: check the connection and try again.
Instead of the PIN to open Evidence, turn off protection and end a trip.
Faster, but someone could force your finger. The PIN is safer.
No fingerprint or face set up on this phone: the PIN is used.
Immediately erases recordings, the log, favourite places and the secret phrase. Keeps your account, contacts and PIN: protection keeps working.
Recordings, the log, favourites and the secret phrase will be erased for good.
The language follows the phone\'s (Android Settings → Language).
A readable file: account, contacts, consents, log. Keep it somewhere safe. Recordings are exported separately, encrypted, from Evidence.
Your account is deleted on the server, then all data on this phone: contacts, recordings, log, settings. This cannot be undone.
Tecno, Infinix and Itel often close apps in the background. In Settings → Battery (or Phone Master), choose \"No restrictions\" for Cercle Rouge and allow auto-start.
Samsung: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: remove Cercle Rouge from sleeping apps and set it to \"Unrestricted\".
Xiaomi / Redmi: Settings → Apps → Cercle Rouge → Battery saver: \"No restrictions\", and turn on \"Autostart\".
Huawei / Honor: Settings → Battery → App launch: set Cercle Rouge to manage manually and tick all three options.
Oppo, Realme, Vivo, OnePlus: Settings → Battery → Cercle Rouge: allow background activity and auto-start.
For protection to keep working with the screen off: Settings → Apps → Cercle Rouge → Battery: \"Unrestricted\".
Verify your number with an SMS code. It is used to confirm a trusted adult\'s consent and to find your account if you change phones. It is never shown to anyone.
Code sent. It can take a minute to arrive.
Could not send the code. Check the connection and try again.
Invitation sent by SMS. The status will change as soon as the contact replies.
This number asked to stop receiving messages from Cercle Rouge.
An invitation was just sent. Try again in an hour.
Could not send. Check the connection and try again.
That\'s your own number: choose an adult\'s.
Too many requests today. Try again tomorrow.
Could not send. Check the connection and try again.
Not confirmed yet. The adult must install Cercle Rouge and accept.
To receive a young person\'s request, verify your number first (above).
%1$s asks you to be their trusted adult
You agree that their automatic protection can work. You will not see any of their data and you can withdraw your consent.
You must be an adult (18 or over) to accept.
You are already the trusted adult of 6 young people, the maximum.
Route: dotted straight line for now.
Street route unavailable: straight line shown.

To trace the route along streets, the start and end of this trip (two coordinates, no name or identifier) are sent to an OpenStreetMap routing service, which also sees your IP address. Cercle Rouge keeps nothing. Without this consent, a straight line is drawn.
High: reacts faster, with more false alarms. Low: only very clear signals. The secret phrase and SOS do not change.
During a concert, sport, driving or sleep, usual sounds (shouts, impacts, horns, alarms) count less. The secret phrase, sure keywords and SOS always work.
Record up to 5 words you would shout in danger (help, anmwe…). Each counts as a strong signal for the AI; with another signal, it asks if you are safe. The secret phrase alerts directly.
Say “%1$s” the way you would shout it.
Suggestions (say them in your own voice):
5 keywords at most: delete one to add another.
Keyword saved. Only this phone recognises it.
A keyword is being recorded, below.
Added at the end of every alert sent to your contacts (not to tests). Example: “Call my sister first.”
To let you find a contact by typing a name, Cercle Rouge needs to read your phone book. Nothing is copied or sent: only the contact you choose is kept, on this phone.
SMS and e-mail work now. WhatsApp and automatic calls are noted for later: they will not be sent yet.
If someone chose you as a contact and you accepted their invitation, their current alert or trip shows here, with their last position. Your number must be verified (Settings).
Nobody has an alert or trip in progress.
Cannot reach the server: retrying automatically.
Summary of your alerts and trips: times, reason, outcome. No position is kept here.
Neutral notifications, no sound and no alert text on screen; only coded vibrations tell you. Android\'s microphone indicator stays visible: it is mandatory.
None chosen: the first 3 contacts who accepted are notified.
3 contacts at most. They get the tracking link if trip watch is on.
Nothing is erased automatically: you delete them yourself in the vault.
⚠ Your evidence will stay on this phone with no time limit. Anyone who gets your PIN could listen to it. Remember to delete it when you no longer need it; the emergency wipe destroys it too.
No details recorded for this alert.
End-to-end encrypted: only your app can play them. Nothing is kept on your phone.
%1$s · alert in progress, still uploading · deleted on %2$s
This recording cannot be opened on this phone (app reinstalled or another phone).
No audio for this alert, only the details.
Cercle Rouge helps you alert quickly, but does not replace emergency services.

Cercle Rouge can help you alert quickly, but it does not replace emergency services. In immediate danger, call emergency services. The app cannot guarantee an alert gets through (network, battery, phone off) and does not predict danger.
Your safety first: if you can, move away from danger, go to a busy, well-lit place, and call for help. Do not fight an attacker to protect your phone.
Choose the country, or leave Auto: your SIM card\'s country is used. Tapping a number opens the dialer; nothing is called without you.
Protection interrupted at %1$s. Open the app to turn it back on.

While protection is on, your phone checks in every 5 min. If it goes silent for 10 min (app force-closed, phone off, broken or stolen), 3 contacts get an SMS with your last position. Requires a verified number.
Notify if my phone shuts down
If the phone is turned off during protection, a last SMS goes straight to 3 contacts, with your position if known.
Enter your account\'s verified number: a code arrives by SMS. Your profile comes back, and your contacts too if their backup was on.
Recordings (evidence) from the old phone are not transferred: they stay encrypted where they were made.
Could not sign in. Check the number and the network, then try again.
No account found for this number. Create your profile.
To get them back on a new phone. They are encrypted on the Cercle Rouge server (like numbers sent during an alert). Turning this off erases the backup.
This phone will be fully erased (evidence included). Your account stays on the server: you can recover it with your number.
To enlarge text, use Android\'s font size (Settings › Display): the app follows up to 200%.
What is off can be turned on later. SOS and SMS to contacts work even without microphone or location.
Tip: Android also has an Emergency SOS (press the power button 5 times on most recent phones). You can turn it on in addition to Cercle Rouge.
Microphone: to recognise your secret phrase and distress words. Everything is analysed on the phone; no sound leaves it.
Location: to share it with your contacts only during an alert or a watched trip.
You can refuse either one: protection then works partly, and SOS is always available.
Support code: %1$s (give it to support if asked; it reveals neither your name nor your number)

Ask a question or say what is happening. Everything stays on your phone.

Card: %1$s · advice to be reviewed by professionals
Sounds: YAMNet on the phone (screams, blows, gunshots, vehicles, parties).
Reasoning: local rules, always checked by the guard.
Language model: not installed yet. The app is complete without it.
One button, in the middle, turns protection on before you go out.
Sounds are analysed on your phone. No sound ever goes online.
Your location is shared only during a trip or an alert.
It does not replace emergency services: 114 is always one tap away.
I\'m walking home, will you stay with me?
Yes. I\'ll tell Jean if you stop for more than 10 min.
Each one has a precise reason. You can change them in settings.
Hear a call for help. Analysed on the phone, never sent.
Share it with your people only during a trip or an alert.
Show that protection is running and alert your people.
Alert your people even without internet.

Your first name appears in messages sent to your people. Your age adapts the protection.
Never shared. Only used to choose the right level of protection.

A parent or trusted adult confirms your sign-up in their app. They become your first contact.
They receive an SMS with a link to confirm.
It cancels an alert, turns protection off and opens the vault. An attacker can\'t cancel anything without it.
4 digits · avoid your date of birth
Say it in a normal voice while protection is on: a silent alert goes to your people.
Choose 3 to 5 words you never say by chance, for example \"the cat sleeps on the moon\".
